text:
Sam: quick heads-up — during last night's canary one of the deploys to the gpu-pool-prod hit an RBAC deny and the pod never started. seeing repeated 403s from k8s audit. :eyes:
Olivia: can you paste the exact deny log?
Sam: paste from kube-apiserver audit: `{"level":"Request","user":{"username":"system:serviceaccount:infra:deploy-sa"},"verb":"create","resource":"pods" ,"responseStatus":{"code":403},"reason":"Forbidden"}`
Jonas: ah — that user should only have patch/exec on the rollout-controller SA. did we recently prune clusterroles?
Sam: yep — rolled out the least-privilege RBAC refactor yesterday. I suspected nothing at the time since unit tests passed but looks like a missing RoleBinding for the gpu-pool namespace.
Maya: do we have KMS logs correlated? I saw one decryption failure for the same timeframe which might be a separate issue.
Sam: KMS partial failure: `decrypt failed: access denied for key arn:aws:kms:...:alias/redwood-secrets` coming from the node that tried to mount the model weights. stack shows both RBAC deny and KMS deny in a ~15s window.
infra-bot: noticed related alert — `deploy-serviceaccount-403` fired 2025-11-03T02:12:33Z. Incident id: INC-20251103-72. Link: https://infra.redwood/alerts/INC-20251103-72
oncall: assigned to @Jonas for initial triage, ETA 30m.
Jonas: immediate mitigation options: 1) reapply a temporary RoleBinding to grant deploy-sa `edit` on namespace gpu-pool-prod, 2) rollback yesterday's RBAC prune, or 3) patch the Role to add the missing verbs. prefer #3 for minimal blast radius.
Olivia: agree — patch Role to include `create`, `get`, `patch` on `pods` and `pods/exec`. Can someone draft the exact patch?
Sam: here's the minimal Role diff I tested locally:
```yaml
kind: Role
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
metadata:
  name: gpu-pool-deploy-role
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["pods","pods/exec"]
  verbs: ["get","create","patch","delete"]
```
Jonas: good. also add a RoleBinding limited to `system:serviceaccount:infra:deploy-sa` and annotate with `rbac-revert:INC-20251103-72` so we can auto-revoke after the rollout.
Maya: for KMS — ops, check IAM permissions for the node role to use the envelope key; looks like the node's instance profile lost `kms:Decrypt` during a policy cleanup. I'll open a separate ticket and attach the principal.
Sam: action items: (1) Jonas apply Role & RoleBinding to gpu-pool-prod (temp, annotated) — will monitor for 10m, (2) Maya open KMS IAM follow-up and rotate the envelope key if we confirm scope leak, (3) Olivia add an e2e that simulates SA+KMS path for gpu deploys.
Jonas: applying now. `kubectl apply -f gpu-deploy-role-temp.yaml --namespace=gpu-pool-prod`
deploy-bot: deploy job 4791 started by Jonas — status: in-progress.
Jonas: pod is starting, logs show successful mount now. no more 403s in the last 2 checks. :thumbsup:
Sam: good catch everyone. follow-up: we need a short retro + doc update so RBAC pruning includes an automated smoke test for gpu namespaces. I'll create a PR to add that to the RBAC repo.
Maya: opened KMS ticket TKT-9832 and linked it to INC-20251103-72.
Olivia: I'll draft the e2e test. tagging this thread in the PR for traceability.
Sam: final note — add audit log filter to emit serviceAccount.username in the alert team dashboard, we missed the quick correlation this time.
Jonas: added dashboard card and a Loki query snippet to detect `system:serviceaccount` denies.
Sam: thanks — closing the oncall incident after after-action notes in the incident board. :white_check_mark:
